lines.zh: 六条腿在石头上敲出细响。
lines.en: Six legs tap a fine rhythm on the stone.

lines.zh: 我沿着矿脉爬，从不走直线。
lines.en: I crawl along the vein and never go straight.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳蹭过岩壁，发着亮。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the rock wall and gleams.

lines.zh: 这层钻石壳很重，走起来慢。
lines.en: This diamond shell is heavy and slows me down.

lines.zh: 我一路啃过去，路就通了。
lines.en: I chew my way along and the path opens.

lines.zh: 石粉落在我的背上，像雪。
lines.en: Stone dust settles on my back like snow.

lines.zh: 我跟着矿里的味道往前。
lines.en: I follow the smell inside the ore forward.

lines.zh: 前面有新鲜的裂缝，我钻进去。
lines.en: There is a fresh crack ahead; I squeeze in.

lines.zh: 我爬得快，但方向常搞错。
lines.en: I crawl fast, but I often get the direction wrong.

lines.zh: 别的白蚁都跟着我的痕迹。
lines.en: The other termites follow the trail I leave.

lines.zh: 我从这块石头挪到那块。
lines.en: I move from this stone to that one.

lines.zh: 我的触角一直在探前面的路。
lines.en: My antennae keep testing the way ahead.

lines.zh: 钻过窄缝时，我的壳会卡住。
lines.en: In narrow cracks my shell gets stuck.

lines.zh: 我一路留下细细的啃痕。
lines.en: I leave thin chew marks all along the way.

lines.zh: 我用颚咬着矿脉，边啃边走。
lines.en: I gnaw the seam with my mandibles and keep walking.

lines.zh: 矿石太硬，我改从旁边的软层绕。
lines.en: The ore is too hard, so I detour through the soft layer.

lines.zh: 我停在矿脉边上，磨着口器。
lines.en: I stop by the vein and grind my mouthparts.

lines.zh: 壳上的钻石映着火光。
lines.en: The diamonds on my shell catch the torchlight.

lines.zh: 我静下来，能听见石头在响。
lines.en: When I go still, I hear the stone creaking.

lines.zh: 我在等矿石再裂开一点。
lines.en: I wait for the ore to crack a little more.

lines.zh: 同伴在我旁边啃，声音很密。
lines.en: My kin chew beside me in a dense rhythm.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖触角，把石屑甩掉。
lines.en: I flick my antennae to shed the grit.

lines.zh: 这层甲太亮，藏不住。
lines.en: This armor is too bright to hide in.

lines.zh: 我贴在矿石上，一动不动。
lines.en: I cling to the ore without moving at all.

lines.zh: 我数着裂缝，一共有七条。
lines.en: I count the cracks; there are seven.

lines.zh: 洞里很闷，可我喜欢这味道。
lines.en: The tunnel is close, but I like the smell.

lines.zh: 我在原地转了一圈，又停下。
lines.en: I turn a full circle and stop again.

lines.zh: 口器上还挂着钻石碎屑。
lines.en: Diamond chips still hang from my mouthparts.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，触角先动了。
lines.en: I look up at you, and my antennae move first.

lines.zh: 你握着镐，握得比谁都紧。
lines.en: I recognize the pickaxe in your hand.

lines.zh: 你身上有矿石的粉末。
lines.en: You are covered in ore dust.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，它压碎过我们。
lines.en: I stare at your boots; they have crushed us before.

lines.zh: 你的火把太亮，我的眼在疼。
lines.en: Your torch is too bright and my eyes ache.

lines.zh: 我在算你的护甲有多厚。
lines.en: I am figuring out how thick your armor is.

lines.zh: 你挖到那块矿了吧。
lines.en: You must have mined that ore.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你蹲下来。
lines.en: I tilt my head as you crouch down.

lines.zh: 你不该敲开那块石头的。
lines.en: You should not have broken that stone open.

lines.zh: 我的壳比你的镐硬，试试看。
lines.en: My shell is harder than your pick; try it.

lines.zh: 镐尖打在壳上，滑开了。
lines.en: The pick tip skidded off my shell.

lines.zh: 我的甲裂了，里面还是硬的。
lines.en: My shell cracked, and it is hard underneath too.

lines.zh: 你把我的腿削掉一根。
lines.en: You sliced one of my legs off.

lines.zh: 这一下只刮花了钻石壳。
lines.en: That only scratched the diamond shell.

lines.zh: 我缩进石头缝里躲了一下。
lines.en: I ducked into a stone crack for a moment.

lines.zh: 疼，可我的壳替我挡了大半。
lines.en: It hurts, but my shell took most of it.

lines.zh: 你打中我的腹部，那里软。
lines.en: You hit my belly, which is the soft part.

lines.zh: 碎掉的甲片落了一地。
lines.en: Broken shell plates scatter across the floor.

lines.zh: 我翻过身，赶紧爬走。
lines.en: I roll over and scramble away quickly.

lines.zh: 触角断了，我方向感差了些。
lines.en: My antenna broke and my sense of direction blurred.

lines.zh: 你手里的矿石，我很感兴趣。
lines.en: The ore in your hand interests me greatly.

lines.zh: 那块带蓝点的石头，递过来。
lines.en: That stone with blue flecks, hand it over.

lines.zh: 我闻到了钻石的味道。
lines.en: I can smell the diamond inside it.

lines.zh: 你拿石头引我，这招有用。
lines.en: Luring me with stone actually works.

lines.zh: 别的我不吃，只啃矿石。
lines.en: I eat nothing else; only ore will do.

lines.zh: 你把矿放地上，我就过去。
lines.en: Set the ore down and I will come over.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑不够我塞牙。
lines.en: Those crumbs are not enough to fill a tooth.

lines.zh: 我跟着这块矿石走了三步。
lines.en: I have followed this ore for three steps.

lines.zh: 你手里那块，比这块纯。
lines.en: The one in your hand is purer than this.

lines.zh: 矿在哪儿，我就往哪儿爬。
lines.en: Wherever the ore is, that is where I crawl.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我的壳凹了一块。
lines.en: You bumped me and my shell dented.

lines.zh: 别踢，钻石壳硬得很。
lines.en: Do not kick; the diamond shell is very hard.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻了个身，六脚朝天。
lines.en: The hit flipped me over, six legs in the air.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，脚底会疼。
lines.en: If you step on me, your sole will hurt.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我推进了石缝。
lines.en: That bump shoved me into a crack.

lines.zh: 我的触角被你碰断了一根。
lines.en: You snapped one of my antennae.

lines.zh: 我们挤在洞里，谁都转不开。
lines.en: We are jammed in the tunnel, neither able to turn.

lines.zh: 你退开，我还要继续啃。
lines.en: Step back; I have chewing to finish.

lines.zh: 撞一下不疼，就是有点晃。
lines.en: A bump does not hurt, only leaves me swaying.

lines.zh: 我的腿在你裤脚上刮了一下。
lines.en: My legs scraped once against your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 矿脉深处有我的巢。
lines.en: My nest lies deep inside the vein.

lines.zh: 我们一群挤在同一块矿石里。
lines.en: We crowd together inside the same ore block.

lines.zh: 幼蚁孵出来就啃石头。
lines.en: The young hatch and start chewing stone.

lines.zh: 我用触角碰了碰同伴。
lines.en: I touch my companion with my antennae.

lines.zh: 巢里温度刚好，石头是暖的。
lines.en: The nest is just warm enough; the stone holds heat.

lines.zh: 我们不吵，只是不停地啃。
lines.en: We do not quarrel; we only chew without pause.

lines.zh: 这块矿够整窝吃很久。
lines.en: This ore will feed the whole nest a long while.

lines.zh: 我从巢里出来，身上带壳粉。
lines.en: I leave the nest dusted with shell powder.

lines.zh: 同伴会跟着我留下的痕迹。
lines.en: My kin will follow the trail I leave.

lines.zh: 巢在下面，我得回去一趟。
lines.en: The nest is below; I must go back once.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块碎钻，夹在颚间。
lines.en: I pick up a diamond shard and clamp it in my jaws.

lines.zh: 这块矿石我要拖回巢里。
lines.en: I will drag this ore back to the nest.

lines.zh: 我用前足推着一粒石英。
lines.en: I push a piece of quartz with my front legs.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的碎屑都是我的。
lines.en: The chips on the ground are all mine.

lines.zh: 太重了，我拖不动这块。
lines.en: It is too heavy; I cannot drag this one.

lines.zh: 我把矿石塞进腮边的囊里。
lines.en: I stuff the ore into the pouch beside my jaw.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，我先看是不是矿。
lines.en: You dropped something; let me check if it is ore.

lines.zh: 这粒小石子，留着垫巢。
lines.en: This pebble will do to line the nest.

lines.zh: 我抱着矿石往缝里钻。
lines.en: I clutch the ore and squeeze into the crack.

lines.zh: 抢我的矿，我会咬你。
lines.en: Take my ore and I will bite you.

lines.zh: 镐声一响，我就知道有人来了。
lines.en: One pickaxe ring and I know someone is here.

lines.zh: 你挖开了我的矿，我盯上你。
lines.en: You broke my ore, so I have marked you.

lines.zh: 这个目标离矿脉很近。
lines.en: This target stands close to the vein.

lines.zh: 我从矿石里探出头，认准了你。
lines.en: I poke out of the ore and fix on you.

lines.zh: 脚步声在洞里传得很清楚。
lines.en: Footsteps carry clearly through the tunnel.

lines.zh: 你身上有新鲜的石粉味。
lines.en: You carry the smell of fresh stone dust.

lines.zh: 我选中你，因为你挖得最多。
lines.en: I chose you because you mined the most.

lines.zh: 目标确认，我的颚开始动了。
lines.en: Target confirmed, and my jaws start working.

lines.zh: 你就在那块矿后面，我听得见。
lines.en: You are behind that ore; I can hear you.

lines.zh: 有人在敲我的巢，必须阻止。
lines.en: Someone is striking my nest; I must stop it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那双靴子。
lines.en: I have locked onto those boots.

lines.zh: 距离不远，我直接冲过去。
lines.en: The distance is short, so I charge straight over.

lines.zh: 我沿着矿脉追，从不绕路。
lines.en: I chase along the vein and never detour.

lines.zh: 你往上爬，我就贴着墙跟。
lines.en: You climb up, so I follow along the wall.

lines.zh: 我听得见你的镐在哪儿响。
lines.en: I can hear where your pickaxe strikes.

lines.zh: 你躲到石柱后面，我绕过去。
lines.en: You hide behind the pillar, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，六条腿不停。
lines.en: I close in step by step, six legs never stopping.

lines.zh: 你的火把暴露了位置。
lines.en: Your torch gives away your position.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚印，一路跟着。
lines.en: I bite onto your trail and follow it.

lines.zh: 洞里到处是我的路，你逃不掉。
lines.en: Every tunnel here is mine; you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 我停下来听，然后又动。
lines.en: I stop to listen, then move again.

lines.zh: 你越往深处走，我越高兴。
lines.en: The deeper you go, the happier I am.

lines.zh: 你往左拐，我已经在那儿。
lines.en: I noted which way you turned.

lines.zh: 你退到矿口，我就堵住出路。
lines.en: You back to the mine mouth, and I block the way.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的小腿，注入疲劳。
lines.en: I bite your calf and inject fatigue.

lines.zh: 这一口，你的镐会变沉。
lines.en: After this bite, your pick will feel heavy.

lines.zh: 我的颚能咬穿皮革。
lines.en: My jaws can bite straight through leather.

lines.zh: 你挥镐慢下来了吧。
lines.en: Your pickaxe is slowing down, is it not.

lines.zh: 疲劳会一点点爬上你的手臂。
lines.en: The fatigue creeps slowly up your arms.

lines.zh: 我挂在你裤腿上不松口。
lines.en: I hang from your trouser leg and will not let go.

lines.zh: 咬完这一下，你连路都走不快。
lines.en: After this bite, you will not even walk fast.

lines.zh: 我的牙口比钻石还硬。
lines.en: My teeth are harder than diamond.

lines.zh: 你身上的护甲缝，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see the gaps in your armor.

lines.zh: 我咬着你的手套，往后退。
lines.en: I bite your glove and pull backwards.

lines.zh: 矿石碎开，我从裂缝里钻出来。
lines.en: The ore splits and I crawl out of the crack.

lines.zh: 你敲开那块石头，我就醒了。
lines.en: You broke that stone and I woke up.

lines.zh: 我从最近的矿脉里爬出。
lines.en: I climb out of the nearest vein.

lines.zh: 石头裂开的声音，是我的门。
lines.en: The sound of splitting stone is my door.

lines.zh: 一整窝在矿里等着破壳。
lines.en: A whole brood waits inside the ore to break out.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着刚钻出的石粉。
lines.en: I still carry the dust of newly bored stone.

lines.zh: 你挖到了不该挖的东西。
lines.en: You mined something you should not have.

lines.zh: 新的裂缝打开，我钻了出来。
lines.en: A new crack opened and I came through.

lines.zh: 我在矿石里长大，从没见光。
lines.en: I grew inside ore and never saw light.

lines.zh: 这一块矿，够出来好几个。
lines.en: This one ore block sends out several of us.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的壳烫得发红。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell until it stings.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下，壳摔出裂纹。
lines.en: Falling from height cracks my shell.

lines.zh: 水里我划不动，慢慢沉。
lines.en: In water I cannot paddle and slowly sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀进石堆里。
lines.en: The blast threw me into a pile of rubble.

lines.zh: 箭擦过壳面，留下白痕。
lines.en: An arrow grazed my shell and left a white mark.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的腿发麻。
lines.en: That force numbs all my legs.

lines.zh: 没有矿石，我只能空着颚。
lines.en: With no ore, my jaws work on nothing.

lines.zh: 雷击下来，我的壳通体发亮。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my whole shell lit up.

lines.zh: 黑里没有石头，我没处可爬。
lines.en: There is no stone in the dark to crawl on.
